description:
Mercury Coder language model

Mercury Coder is served by Inception over an OpenAI-compatible API with a 32000-token context window. Requests are proxied through the UnitySVC gateway and billed per token.

Reach it through the UnitySVC gateway with your own Inception API key (the byok channel). The endpoint accepts both OpenAI Chat Completions and Anthropic Messages requests — the gateway auto-detects the dialect, translates to the upstream, and returns the response in the format you sent.
name: mercury-coder

payout_price.description: Service provider charges $0.25 / $1 per 1M input/output tokens
